gloss: various places around the world; all over the world

definitions.gloss: various places around the world; all over the world
definitions.explanation: Many different locations throughout the world, emphasizing geographical spread.

examples.japanese: {世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Tourists visit from all over the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: This problem is occurring in various places around the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧や{食|しょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れて→触れる：01984_fureru⟧きた。
examples.english: He has traveled all over the world, experiencing the culture and food of each place.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (world) and ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧ (various places). Very common in news reporting and formal writing. Emphasizes that something is happening broadly across many locations, not just one or two.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in various parts of the world
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from all over the world
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: to various places around the world
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to travel around the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧: all over the world — emphasizes totality (everywhere) rather than diversity of locations
- ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧: various countries — focuses on national units rather than geographical places
- {世界各国|せかいかっこく}: countries around the world
